name: Teleport
shortDescription: Private collaboration rooms for chat, calls, bots, and workflows.
description:
Teleport is a private collaboration application for Sandstorm and Melusina. Create a Call Room for peer-to-peer audio/video, persistent real-time chat, files, screen sharing, room notifications, transcript export, and retention controls. The unified package also includes BotMother, Telegram, Chatroom, Instance, and Station grain types.

Calls runs as a native Go MainView/UiView/WebSession pearl. It does not use a sidecar or sandstorm-http-bridge; chat, notifications, WebRTC signaling, Jinn participation, and the revocable Cap'n Proto ChatHook stay inside the pearl, while media flows peer-to-peer between participants. Clientspace-style integrations can restore the standard UiView and offer it natively.
